arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Low left-facing worker crouch. Far arm lifts ONE short-handled dark charcoal hammer high above his head, gripping the nearly horizontal handle; the hammer head is at the screen-RIGHT end. Near arm extends diagonally down-left toward the work area with empty hand. Face looks left/down, one profile eye. Torso nearly horizontal, left planted supporting leg under hips, right knee bent back. Only one hand on hammer, no two-handed overhead grip. Preserve the exact source hammer position and small isolated lower-left blue source mark without inventing another foot. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
